I will sow the sorghum seed I saved from last year, mixed with cowpeas the way my father taught me. I will spread manure from my goats on this plot because it is mine and I want the soil to stay soft, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer — the agro-dealer is far and one bag costs more than I have. My wife and children will do all the work from clearing to threshing, about 120 days between us, and I will not hire anyone because I have no extra cash for wages.
